verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail (Virtual Mail) exposes a public API and an MCP server, so this axis applies. However, its docs describe a single static key tied to the user account that "can reach every mailbox you have access to," which is the opposite of scoped or least-privilege credentials. The MCP server inherits the user's full account permissions, and multi-user mailbox access is an adjacent collaboration feature, not credential scoping, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
